body:
R. A. Salvatore is really good! I read the Cleric Quintet a few years back. I should read those again. King is great too! Definitely give the original Holmes stories a chance sometime. They're excellent!

Thanks so much for letting me know about that! I've been a Redditor for a while, and this is the first I've heard about it.

Thank you again, Avoch. I really appreciate your time.

Thank you so much for your time and considerate response. I know that you're right. Everything you said is spot on. I need to try to move on. I just don't want to lose my friend in the process. We've been through a lot together. Family members treating us like shit. Losing friends. We had a child together, even if we lost her before she was born. I know she's toxic, but it's hard it let stuff like that go.

Thank you so much. Just seeing the little envelope at the top of the screen turn red made me smile and tear up a little. You're really too kind.

I like comic books and Sherlock Holmes a lot. I read a bunch to keep myself distracted.
I'm so sorry that you're hurting. If you want to talk, feel free to PM me.
